description: Draws the contents list in a narrower measure than the page, so each entry sits closer to its page number instead of being separated by the full width of the page. The built-in toc.indent only indents nested levels and never moves the right edge, so this adds the two settings that were missing.

themeKeys.description: Space between the left margin and the contents list.
Space between the contents list and the right margin. This is the one that pulls page numbers in toward their entries.

sampleContent: The contents list is drawn in a narrower measure, so entries and their page numbers sit closer together.
